name: home-assistant
install: uv pip install -q --python {py} -e . $(for d in packages/hassfest packages/pytest-homeassistant; do test -d $d && echo -e $d; done) --config-settings editable_mode=compat

ci.source: .github/workflows/ci.yaml pytest-full: 10 groups x --numprocesses logical (4 vCPU), --dist=loadfile; dev-branch pushes always run the full suite

ci_cmd: {py} -m script.split_tests {groups} tests > /dev/null && {py} -b -X dev -m pytest -qq --timeout=9 --durations=0 --durations-min=1 --numprocesses logical --snapshot-details --dist=loadfile -o console_output_style=count -p no:sugar --exclude-warning-annotations --junitxml={report} -o junit_family=legacy $(sed -n "{group},1p" pytest_buckets.txt)
